description: Standalone Cavecrew review of supplied diff or files. Read-only findings; does not replace the SDD review gate.

bindings.files.read: Native file reading or permitted shell read
bindings.files.search: Native search or permitted shell search
bindings.git.diff: Native shell restricted to git diff, git log -p, git show

adaptations: Shared full/lite/off policy overrides upstream ultra. Inherit authorized runtime model instead of upstream haiku. Keep read-only scope and findings semantics. No SDD stage replacement.
